sections.text: Synthetic fertilizers and pesticides are the two chemical pillars of industrial agriculture. Together they enabled the Green Revolution's yield increases — but at scale and duration, they impose costs: N pollution cascading through waterways, pesticide resistance, non-target mortality, and soil biology disruption. The discipline of Integrated Pest Management (IPM) and precision nutrient management represent attempts to get the benefits while reducing the costs.
